symbol.name: The Tile
symbol.description: A square with two opposite quarter-circles (radius = half the side) removed. A Truchet tile: alone it is the mark; repeated at random 0°/90° rotations it becomes the brand pattern.
symbol.orientation: Cut corners top-left and bottom-right. Do not rotate the standalone symbol.
symbol.clearSpace: 25 units (1/4 of the symbol) on every side

signal.role: Optional accent: pattern backgrounds, highlights, links. Never inside the symbol.

typography.wordmark: Geist Medium, tracking -1.5%, outlined to vector paths. Never retype.

lockups.horizontal: wordmark cap height = 0.44 × symbol height; gap 30 units; caps centered on symbol
